Source snapshot: DMs Revenue Flow public investor page, https://dmrevenueflow.com/
Snapshot date: 2026-05-21

DMs Revenue Flow describes itself as an AI-powered content and DM revenue engine that turns direct messages into qualified leads and measurable revenue.

The product narrative says the system combines AI content production, social distribution, comment detection, instant DM response, lead qualification, personalized offers, and upsell follow-up sequences.

The page says the core differentiator is an AI-assisted agent operating inside every DM inbox with human-in-the-loop escalation for high-value deals.

The public page describes the opportunity as a pre-seed investment and says the company is seeking strategic investors.
